newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine govt forecasts 25 pct inflation in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine govt forecasts 25 pct inflation in 1997.

text.p: Ukraine has forecast a 25 percent annual inflation rate for next year, a government statement said on Tuesday.
Inflation in the first eight months of 1996 was 32.2 percent and is expected to reach 45 percent for the full year, after 182 percent in 1995.
"This (1997) level is seen as one that can increase production," the statement quoted Finance Minister Valentyn Koronevsky as telling a cabinet meeting to review the 1997 budget.
The 1997 budget is due to be presented to parliament on Thursday.
